name: estaya
description: Estaya public website. Astro builds the static site into public/ for Firebase Hosting.

scripts.typecheck: astro check && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.lint: astro check && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test:emulator: node functions/scripts/ensure-dev-secret.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions "node functions/scripts/emulator-check.mjs"
scripts.emulators: node functions/scripts/ensure-dev-secret.mjs && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,functions,firestore
